title: Mitch Woods - Boogie Woogie Bar B Que

lines.l: Come on in, don't worry about a thing
It won't take long for the band to swing
Get yourself, mama, cut the rug
Grab yourself a beer and chug a lug
Well, they're legs and ribs, chicken and fries
Texas women, lots of Texas heat
A red hot band with a solid boogie beat
Chicken, fried, steak, and all sorts of
